answer: At the dawn of each epoch, every identity bond starts decaying: 5 POA per epoch off a 100 POA bond, unless honest work renews it. Bonds sit in a public vault: minting 1,000 fakes locks 100,000 POA and bleeds 5,000 POA each epoch to keep them alive. A quartz clock times the decay, tamper-proof, so fakes cannot pause it; decayed bonds fund the jury pool. An honest agent pays one bond, renews it with real work, and keeps full rewards undiluted.
